source_text:
4.5
̓Οργίζεσθε, καὶ μὴ ἁμαρτάνετε.
Παραινεῖ μὴ συγκατατίθεσθαι τῇ φαντα σίᾳ, μηδὲ τὸ ε ργον ἐπάγειν κυροῦν τὴν
Θυσία
ὀργήν.
pass_a_gloss: Be-ye-angry, and not do-ye-sin. He-exhorts not to-assent to-the appearance, nor the deed to-bring-on confirming the anger.
pass_b_english: He exhorts not to assent to the appearance, nor to bring on the deed confirming the anger.

choices.why: Stoic sunkatathesis: give assent to an impression. φαντασία is appearance, not English phantasy.

choices.term: τὸ ἔργον ἐπάγειν κυροῦν τὴν ὀργήν
choices.english: to bring on the deed confirming the anger
choices.why: κυροῦν is from κυρόω (ratify), not κυριεύω (rule). ἔργον is the act that makes the anger valid.
rejected: let the work lead to ruling anger

choices.why: Lock prints Θυσία between τὴν and ὀργήν. 4.6 begins Θύσατε θυσίαν; do not read sacrifice into 4.5.

anf_compare.notes: ANF lacks this Greek catena as reading English.
